verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents encrypted sync to personal iCloud or Google Drive, a recoverable cloud backup if the phone is lost, and export files, so tokens can be carried to a new phone. The evidence never describes a guided, single-step phone-migration flow or cross-platform (iOS↔Android) restore, so delivery of the story as written is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented guided one-step migration flow, cross-platform transfer details, and hands-on corroboration that all tokens restore on a new device.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive to protect yourself from losing Tokens in case of phone damage or loss.
Even if you lose your mobile device, you can recover service keys because they are stored in a secure cloud backup.
Synchronize your Tokens with 2FAS export files, iCloud or Google Drive.
